# Filter the dataframe to find the row with title "Robin Hood Play"
robin_hood_row = df[df['Title'] == 'Robin Hood Play']

# Get the season number and series number of that episode
season_num = robin_hood_row['Season #'].iloc[0]
series_num = robin_hood_row['Series #'].iloc[0]

# Find the previous episode: same season, series number one less
prev_episode = df[(df['Season #'] == season_num) & (df['Series #'] == series_num - 1)]

# Extract the title of the previous episode
answer = prev_episode['Title'].iloc[0]
